relations.description: UE in single-registration mode not registered over 3GPP access must be in EMM-DEREGISTERED state
UE in single-registration mode not registered over 3GPP access must be in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for 3GPP access
Successful registration procedure in N1 mode establishes 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state
Successful registration procedure in N1 mode establishes EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode establishes EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode establishes 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode includes initiating registration procedure
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS registration type IE
5GS registration type IE indicates mobility registration updating for the registration procedure
